sentence-transformers was an editable install of a PR branch (#3918), not a release. The change replaces an unconditional self.to(device) in encode with a guarded one. Ruled out empirically: this build reproduces the v1 published numbers exactly to four decimals (0.9655/0.9440/0.9751/0.9588/1.0000), which a build that altered embeddings could not. Re-run on a released sentence-transformers before publishing.
